params.body:
## Summary

Six large cards showed little of a stock of 2.600. The home page now shows the stock the way the dealer sites in the sector do.

- **Nieuw in ons aanbod**: the eight newest vehicles in four columns, in a compact card (smaller type, no button, price kept). Only vehicles with a photo, make, model and price; parts, bodies and cars stay out of this row. Sorted by first registration, so the 2025 and 2026 arrivals come first.
- **A row per category**: the four largest categories in stock at the moment (today Vrachtwagens, Kipwagens, Aanhangwagens, Opleggers), four vehicles each with a link to the full category. A vehicle appears on the home page once. `config/home.php` holds the sizes, the exclusions and an optional fixed list of categories.
- No "own stock first" on the home page: that would pin the same 35 S-numbered vehicles on top and repeat them in every row. The lists and the detail page keep own stock first.

Suite: 46 tests (two new for the home stock). Checked in a headless browser on desktop and phone widths: 20 cards, no script errors.

## After merge

Deploy; nothing else.
